- Normal hemoglobin (13 g/dL) and absence of systemic symptoms (no weight loss, fever, night sweats, nausea, or vomiting) make significant organic disease (e.g., malignancy, severe infection, or active IBD) less likely.  
- Mild leukocytosis (WBC 11,000/mm³) with neutrophil predominance is nonspecific and could reflect low-grade stress, subclinical infection, or even functional GI disorders; it is not alarming in isolation.
